en.heading: How We Work
en.description: A transparent four-step workflow from initial requirements to deployment and ongoing website care.

steps.title: Requirements & Scope
steps.description: We discuss your goals, required pages, and features to recommend the right fit across WordPress, React, Node.js, or custom code.

steps.title: Structure & UI Plan
steps.description: We align on page hierarchy, responsive wireframes, and clear calls to action before full implementation begins.

steps.title: Build & Deployment
steps.description: We write clean code, integrate APIs or CMS controls, test performance across devices, and launch safely on your domain.

steps.title: Maintenance & Growth
steps.description: After launch, we support your website with security updates, bug fixes, backups, content edits, and speed tuning.
